title: Unique Ground-State Representability under Linear Constraints
exact_target: Extend the finite-dimensional constrained-search and multiplier theory to an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006231 (OWR-14299094-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mathematical Methods in Quantum Chemistry (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/15, pp. 615--688. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The catalogue wording below summarizes finite-dimensional uniqueness and degenerate cases. The primary report already develops those cases under its stated independent-observable assumptions; its explicit open question is the infinite-dimensional extension. Linear dependence of the original observable family is excluded in the report's finite-dimensional setup.
